text_block_list.text:
Memories of numerous victories come 
flooding back... Indeed, Mejiro Palmer was 
exceptionally strong in festival-like 
races.

Winning the Arima Kinen, the Takarazuka 
Kinen, and the Arima Kinen once again in 
rapid succession—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What?! What, what, what...? A three-peat 
Grand Prix champion?! Me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I did pretty well if I do say so 
myself! But, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even for the same feat, pulling it off in 
a fan-voted race is just so like me, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess festive, lively races where I can 
party with everyone really suit me best 
after all!
choice_data_list:
Speaking of festivals, apparently they're 
throwing a celebration too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for a 3-year winning streak? I see. I 
guess that makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, we went totally wild during the 
race, so let's keep things nice and tame 
for the celebration.

And during the rehearsal for the 
celebration...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, it is not bad, but their conduct on 
the podium is somewhat..."

Student Council President Symboli Rudolf 
repeatedly tilted her head in puzzlement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Madam President? Is there something... 
big-time wrong with how I accepted the 
trophy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even do any party-people moves 
today, so there's nothing strange going 
on...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not that it's bad, but when you're acting 
as yourself, you almost seem excessively 
humble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back, you can stand tall with 
pride, you know? Winning three consecutive 
Grand Prix is a magnificent feat not seen 
since that person I so deeply revere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to be 'proud and 
confident'~... Well, being overly humble 
is something that's been ingrained in me 
since I was a kid, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mmm, what should I do about this...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The lack of dignity in your demeanor is 
likely due to the angle of your head tilt.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
How about trying to raise your head 
position? Let's see... by about 2.85 
degrees.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Head position... I see. Maybe because I 
always end up doing that casual 'Hey 
there~♪' thing, I didn't look dignified 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Bourbon, roger that! Then I'll try 
keeping my head up higher!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please do. It'd honestly make me happier 
if you stayed firm and resolute.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-san, you are the pinnacle that all 
Front Runners aspire to reach.

And so, the ceremony concluded without a 
hitch, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer? Wasn't your pace really 
good just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It felt super easy to run in, or rather... 
How's my time—!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
W-What's going on? What on earth 
happened...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Is it simply the result of accumulated 
training? Or could it be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Head position... Like during that 
ceremony...

Correcting posture. In other words— that 
might have led to correcting one's state 
of mind as well.

In other words, to claim the pride fitting 
for an Umamusume who achieved a 3-peat in 
the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. When your mindset changes, your 
running changes. Keep your head held high! 
That's the idea, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, chin up, chest puffed out 
with pride, let's go for four or five 
consecutive wins in a row!!"

Brimming with confidence. And the vibes 
are rising even higher.

With the pride of three consecutive Grand 
Prix victories in her heart, Mejiro Palmer 
will continue to take on new banquets.
